final.answer: GV-1-2 is a servo-controlled 2/2-way diaphragm solenoid valve (Type 165, fail-safe to close). The humming indicates the coil is energized, so the likely fault is hydraulic rather than electrical: this servo-operated valve needs a minimum differential pressure of 0.5 bar to open and close, and its working pressure range is 0.5–6 bar. If the differential pressure across the valve is below 0.5 bar (or the upstream pressure is too low), the pilot/diaphragm cannot lift and the valve stays closed while the coil hums. Other contributing possibilities consistent with the datasheet are a supply voltage outside the ±10% tolerance (weakening the coil), or media contamination — the valve is rated only for clean liquids without solid particles, so debris could be blocking the servo passage.
